dedupe_keys.name: environics analytics atm locations database united states

description: A commercial point database of automated teller machines in the United States. The Environics Analytics page says it identifies over 415,000 ATM locations with their parent institution, legal name, sponsor and owner, built from data that Mastercard member institutions must report every 90 days, geocoded for mapping, and that ATMs are removed if they have not reported in 13 months. It is accessed through the Location Lists tool in the ENVISION software, sold by the company. Coverage is the United States, every ATM that accepts Mastercard. Caveats: it is paid, and ATMs outside the Mastercard network are not covered. For simulation it maps where people can get cash, to model access to cash when power, telecom or payment networks fail after disasters. A related catalogue record is the FDIC BankFind Suite.
